class.name: DrapeHullSolver
class.brief_description: Holds cloth between two unions of convex pieces and above a seat.
class.description: Builds a seated garment's shape: the cloth may not enter the inner union of convex pieces nor leave the outer one, and may not pass below a seat plane inside a footprint. The pieces are given by [method set_hull] and the seat by [method set_seat]. [method solve] settles a starting shape and keeps its edges whole.

method.name: clamp_point
method.description: [param point] moved into the outer union ([method pull_in]), then out of the inner one ([method push_out]). The inner union wins where they disagree.

method.name: get_centres
method.description: Per piece, the centre of the sphere bounding it.

method.name: get_faults
method.description: How many hanging vertices the last [method solve] left inside the inner union or under the seat.

method.name: get_largest
method.description: The largest change the last pass of the last [method solve] made to an edge.

method.name: get_passes_run
method.description: How many passes the last [method solve] ran.

method.name: get_radii
method.description: Per piece, the radius of the sphere bounding it; [constant @GDScript.INF] for a piece with no corners.

method.name: in_footprint
method.description: Whether [param point], projected onto the seat's plane, is within the footprint.

method.name: inside_inner
method.description: Whether [param point] is inside an inner piece by more than [param tolerance].

method.name: inside_outer
method.description: Whether [param point] is inside an outer piece, within [param tolerance]. Always [code]true[/code] when there is no outer piece.

method.name: on_seat
method.description: [param point] lifted onto the seat when it is below it inside the footprint.

method.name: pull_in
method.description: [param point], or the nearest point to it in the nearest outer piece when it is in none.

method.name: push_out
method.description: [param point] moved out of every inner piece, through the nearest face whose far side is in no other piece.

method.name: set_hull
method.description: Sets the pieces. [param planes] holds every piece's planes in turn: [code]xyz[/code] the outward normal and [code]w[/code] the offset, with the inside where the normal's dot product with a point is at most [code]w[/code]. [param piece_ends] gives the index past each piece's last plane, and [param outer] whether each piece is an outer one.

method.name: set_seat
method.description: Sets the seat: the plane facing [param up] at height [param level] along it. It holds only within the footprint: within each [param reaches] of the segment between each pair of points in [param footprint], all projected onto the plane.

method.name: set_tuning
method.description: How far past a face a clamped point is put, how far above the seat a lifted point is put, how many times a point is pushed out of the inner union, and how many passes project a point onto an outer piece.

method.name: settle
method.description: [param point] clamped ([method clamp_point]), then lifted onto the seat ([method on_seat]).

method.name: solve
method.description: Settles each vertex of [param start] whose [param hanging] is above [code]0[/code], then runs up to [param passes] passes. Each pass holds every edge of the triangles [param indices] between two vertices with [param hanging] [code]1[/code] between its length in [param rest] and [param max_stretch] times it, and settles again each vertex an edge moved. The passes end once no edge is more than [param settled] from its allowed length. Vertices with [param hanging] [code]0[/code] are returned as given. Hanging vertices left more than [param fault] inside the inner union or under the seat are counted ([method get_faults]).

method.name: under_seat
method.description: Whether [param point] is more than [param tolerance] below the seat inside the footprint.
